blog_title: Royal Blue vs Navy T-Shirt Colour Difference — ₹45K Bulk Order Cancelled Over 1 Shade
caption:
₹45K bulk order. Cancelled. Over ONE shade. 😬

Buyer ordered 300 Royal Blue tees for printing. Arrived looking Navy. On screen? They're twins. On fabric in sunlight? Completely different animals.

Royal Blue is bright and crisp. Navy has that dark depth. Indoor light hides it. Sunlight exposes everything.

Don't learn this the hard way — always pull 2-3 physical samples first. Check them in natural light before you commit to the big order.

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for your next print run 👇
